description:
Implement the canonical serialization format for `FieldMatrix` carrying the algebraic field identity and a separately versioned element-representation header field, with checksummed payloads, atomic file replacement, and validated load-back, using core-owned IO error types.

## Background

The existing `.gf2` BitMatrix format has no checksum, non-atomic writes, and no field identity; its only production round trip is the LDPC cache and it stays untouched. The new format is field-generic, reuses the repository's atomic write-rename pattern and BLAKE3 integrity precedent, and deliberately carries no code-specific metadata. Errors are gf2-core IO types; coding-side errors never appear here.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Saving a `FieldMatrix` writes a versioned format carrying the algebraic field identity and the element-representation header with a checksummed payload, via write-temp, sync, atomic rename.
- [hard] REQ-02: Loading validates identity, representation, and checksum, returns the saved matrix losslessly, and reports any mismatch or corruption as a typed core-owned error.
- [hard] REQ-03: Round-trip and corruption tests cover binary and nonbinary fields, including a runtime/compile-time identity match case.
title: Canonical checksummed FieldMatrix serialization with atomic replacement
